blocks.task_summary: Find the area of sector BOA with radius 19.5 cm and angle 210°.
method_path: Apply sector area formula: (1/2) × r² × θ = (1/2) × 19.5² × (7π/6)

evidence.basis: EITHER 210° = 210π/180 = 7π/6 radians (A1); attempt to use radian formula for area of sector (M1); area = (1/2)(19.5²)(7π/6) OR attempt to use degree formula for area of sector (M1); area = (210/360)π(19.5²) (A1); THEN area = 3549π/16 = 696.844... ≈ 697 cm² A1

blocks.task_summary: Find the radius of the cone formed by joining the radii of the sector.
method_path: Calculate arc length of sector: arc = rθ = 19.5 × (7π/6) = 91π/4 ≈ 71.4712 cm
Set arc length equal to circumference of cone base: 2πr_cone = 71.4712
accepted_alternatives: Use area from part (a): set π × r_cone × 19.5 = area, solve for r_cone

evidence.basis: EITHER arc length = 19.5 × (7π/6) OR (210/360) × 2π × 19.5 = 91π/4 = 71.4712... (A1); attempt to set 2πr equal to arc length (M1); 2πr = 71.4712... OR attempt to set πrl equal to their area from (a) (M1); 19.5πr = 696.844... (A1); THEN r = 91/8 = 11.375 ≈ 11.4 cm A1
